envelope.note:
reused: testkit.world, testkit.run, testkit.fakes
World owns each case; every subprocess is run with a timeout; gh, cue and ruff are planted through world.tools. Kit gap: World.stage copies siblings beside the subject, not a parent-relative data file, so test_pr_proof plants hooks/boundaries.json next to the staged copy. StaleClone, bash_payload, write_payload, permission_decision and has_additional_context stay in the family's support.py. Hook decisions are Claude JSON on stdout, so these tables do not join testkit.refusal-wire. No regression rows were added because this was a behavior-preserving migration. Implementation and the session store were not read. Only the four scoped modules changed. Also reused: agentscient-lane lane_brief, lane_jobs, lane_changes, lane_findings; docs/tests.md; in/testkit-migration-guide.md.
